scripts.text: Welcome to Alberta, the Port City.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到港口城市艾尔帕兰。

scripts.text: In Alberta, you can find the Merchant guild where adventurers can change their job to merchant
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰设有商人公会，冒险者可以在那里转职为商人。

scripts.text: As a city that provides dependable sea travel, Alberta has provided the means for the foreign commerce that has brought prosperity to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰提供可靠的海上运输，促进了对外贸易，为卢恩-米德加兹王国带来繁荣。

scripts.text: On the docks, you may find representatives from foreign lands that will guide tourists to their countries.
scripts.translation: 在码头上，你可以找到来自异国的代表，他们会带游客前往自己的国家。

scripts.text: Among seafarers, there is a rumor of a place known as ^338C60Turtle Island^000000. Intrepid adventurers may seek to investigate this rumor and learn the truth for themselves
scripts.translation: 水手间流传着一个传闻，说有个名为^338C60乌龟岛^000000的地方。勇敢的冒险者不妨亲自前往调查，揭开真相。

scripts.text: There is also a sunken ship that has been discovered near Alberta, and it has become a popular area for adventurers to explore
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰附近还发现了一艘沉船，如今那里已成为冒险者们喜爱的探索地点。

scripts.text: From Alberta, ^1F3A11Payon^000000 is located to the Northwest. You can board passenger ships at the dock to travel to ^5E5C69Izlude^000000.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔帕兰往西北方是^1F3A11斐扬^000000。你也可以在码头乘坐客船前往^5E5C69伊兹鲁德^000000。

scripts.text: Welcome to Geffen, the City of Magic. Geffen is well known for its various legends related to magic.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到魔法之都吉芬。吉芬以各种与魔法有关的传说而闻名。

scripts.text: Points of interest in the city include the Forge, where people can change their jobs to Blacksmith, the Magic Academy for aspiring mages, and the Geffen Tower for the Wizard job change.
scripts.translation: 城内值得一看的地方包括可以转职为铁匠的锻造场、供魔法师学徒学习的魔法学院，以及可以转职为巫师的吉芬塔。

scripts.text: Underneath the Geffen Tower lies a dungeon in which dreadful monsters are rumored to appear.
scripts.translation: 吉芬塔地下有一座地下城，据说会出现可怕的魔物。

scripts.text: It is said that the lost city of Gefenia, a place of elven lore and legend, is hidden within the depths of this dungeon.
scripts.translation: 据说，传说中精灵居住的失落之城吉芬尼亚，就隐藏在这座地下城深处。

scripts.text: From Geffen, the ^828E28Orc Village^000000 is located to the South, ^4C6055Glast Heim^000000 to the West, ^6D6FE0Prontera^000000 to the far East, and ^744B2DMt. Mjolnir^000000 to the North. Enjoy your stay here in Geffen.
scripts.translation: 从吉芬往南是^828E28兽人村落^000000，往西是^4C6055古城^000000，往东边远处是^6D6FE0普隆德拉^000000，往北是^744B2D妙勒尼山脉^000000。祝你在吉芬过得愉快。

scripts.text: The Izlude dungeon is comprised of 5 levels. The first few levels are suited for newer adventurers.
scripts.translation: 伊兹鲁德地下城共有5层，前几层适合刚入门的冒险者。

scripts.text: As you venture deeper into the Byalan dungeon, you will encounter stronger, more powerful monsters.
scripts.translation: 深入海底洞穴后，你会遇到更强大的魔物。

scripts.text: With a few exceptions, most of the monsters in this dungeon are of the Water attribute. Therefore, a Wind attribute weapon will help you greatly
scripts.translation: 除少数例外，这座地下城里的魔物大多为水属性。因此，使用风属性武器会很有帮助。

scripts.text: Welcome to Payon, the mountain city. Payon has recently been renovated, so we hope you enjoy the clean, nice streets and buildings.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到山城斐扬。斐扬最近经过整修，希望你喜欢这里整洁美观的街道和建筑。

scripts.text: Payon is famous for being a city of archery. For a long time, its citizens have made their living by hunting with bows and arrows. Bow crafting and training have also been developed here in Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬以弓术之城闻名。长久以来，居民都靠弓箭狩猎为生，制弓和弓术训练也在这里发展起来。

scripts.text: Payon has various armor and weapons, especially for the Archer class. If you wish to become an Archer, it would be best to become familiar with this city.
scripts.translation: 斐扬有各种铠甲和武器，尤其适合弓箭手。如果你想成为弓箭手，最好先熟悉这座城市。

scripts.text: Payon Palace is located in the center of the city. The Archer Village is located in the Northern part of Payon. There, people can change their jobs to Archer.
scripts.translation: 斐扬宫殿位于市中心，弓箭手村则在斐扬北部。冒险者可以在那里转职为弓箭手。

scripts.text: Near the Archer Village, you can find the ^2F0400Payon Cave^000000 where Undead monsters reside.
scripts.translation: 弓箭手村附近有^2F0400斐扬洞穴^000000，里面栖息着不死系魔物。

scripts.text: From Payon, ^123972Alberta^000000 is located to the Southeast, and ^866C4BMorocc^000000 is to the West. ^5E5C69Izlude^000000 and ^6D6FE0Prontera^000000 are North of Payon.
scripts.translation: 从斐扬往东南方是^123972艾尔帕兰^000000，往西是^866C4B梦罗克^000000。^5E5C69伊兹鲁德^000000和^6D6FE0普隆德拉^000000位于斐扬北方。

scripts.text: Welcome to the Payon Archer Village where Novices can change their jobs to Archer.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到斐扬弓箭手村，新手可以在这里转职为弓箭手。

scripts.text: The Archer Village provides Bows and Tights that are available for purchase. These are necessities for new Archers and Hunters.
scripts.translation: 弓箭手村出售弓和紧身衣，这些都是新晋弓箭手与猎人必备的装备。

scripts.text: If you wish to become an Archer, it is suggested to become familiar with this village. For aspiring Hunters, the Hunter Guild is located in a field that is East of Payon.
scripts.translation: 想成为弓箭手的话，建议先熟悉这个村子。想成为猎人的话，猎人公会位于斐扬东边的原野。

scripts.text: Welcome to Prontera, the capital city of Rune-Midgard.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到卢恩-米德加兹王国的首都普隆德拉。

scripts.text: Prontera is located in the center of the Rune-Midgard continent and is very well-known as a city of flourishing commerce.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉位于卢恩-米德加兹大陆中央，以繁荣的商业闻名。

scripts.text: In this city, you can fint the Sanctuary, where people can change their jobs to Acolyte and Priest.
scripts.translation: 城内有圣殿，冒险者可以在那里转职为服事或牧师。

scripts.text: You can also find the Castle, where people can change their jobs to Crusader.
scripts.translation: 你还可以找到城堡，冒险者可以在那里转职为十字军。

scripts.text: Please feel free to explore the streets of Prontera, as there are various tourist attractions within the city.
scripts.translation: 欢迎在普隆德拉的街道上四处游览，城内有许多观光景点。

scripts.text: When you need to upgrade your weapons and armors, please visit the building in the 5 o'clock direction from the fountain in the center of Prontera.
scripts.translation: 需要升级武器或防具时，请前往普隆德拉中央喷泉的西南方（五点钟方向）的建筑。

scripts.text: From Prontera, ^5E5C69Izlude^000000 is located to the Southeast, ^1F3A11Payon^000000 to the far South, ^683C1FGeffen^000000 to the far West and ^2D3832Al De Baran^000000 to the far North.
scripts.translation: 从普隆德拉往东南方是^5E5C69伊兹鲁德^000000，往南边远处是^1F3A11斐扬^000000，往西边远处是^683C1F吉芬^000000，往北边远处是^2D3832艾尔帕兰^000000。
祝你在普隆德拉玩得愉快。

scripts.text: Welcome to Morocc, the City of the Desert. Morocc was built on an oasis, so this town can accomodate its many visitors and travelers.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到沙漠之城梦罗克。梦罗克建在绿洲上，足以接待众多访客和旅人。

scripts.text: Morocc Castle lies in the center of this city. Please feel free to explore this town, and enjoy its unique atmosphere. However, watch your pockets and beware of Rogues and Thieves.
scripts.translation: 梦罗克城堡位于市中心。欢迎在镇上四处游览，感受这里独特的氛围。不过要看好钱包，小心盗贼和小偷。

scripts.text: From Morocc, the ^660000Pyramid Dungeon^000000 can be found to the Northwest, and the ^660000Sphinx Dungeon^000000 can be found to the West. To the Southeast, you may find ^660000Ant Hell^000000.
scripts.translation: 从梦罗克往西北方可以找到^660000金字塔地下城^000000，往西是^660000斯芬克斯地下城^000000，往东南方则是^660000蚂蚁地狱^000000。

scripts.text: The Assassin Guild is rumored to be located to the Southeast. When you head East from Morocc, and then North, you will arrive at ^3355FFProntera^000000.
scripts.translation: 据说刺客公会位于东南方。从梦罗克向东再向北走，就能到达^3355FF普隆德拉^000000。

scripts.text: Welcome to Niflheim, the City of the Dead.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到死者之都尼夫海姆。

scripts.text: Niflheim was known as the other world where
scripts.translation: 尼夫海姆被认为是人死后

scripts.text: However, recently people found out a secret path behind of a mysterious tree.
scripts.translation: 不过最近，人们发现神秘树木后方有一条秘密通道。

scripts.text: So, you will find many other people travelling around this area.
scripts.translation: 因此，你会看到许多人在这一带旅行。

scripts.text: As a tourist attraction, The Witch's castle is suggested.
scripts.translation: 推荐你去参观女巫的城堡。

scripts.text: Unlike normal towns, it is prohibited to save respawn point or

scripts.text: warp point inside Niflheim. Also monsters spawn within the town as well.
scripts.translation: 或传送点，而且镇内也会出现魔物。

scripts.text: Especially, please be attentive with a boss monster
When you go ahead west, you will arrive at ^6B1312Valley of Gyoll^000000
scripts.translation: 继续向西就会到达^6B1312吉奥尔山谷^000000，

scripts.text: where all the powerful and fearful monsters dwell upon.
scripts.translation: 那里栖息着许多强大而可怕的魔物。

scripts.text: It is suggested to leave the area immediately in case of a new solo adventurer.
scripts.translation: 刚出道的冒险者最好立即离开此地。

scripts.text: Glast Heim is an enormous dungeon with countless levels.
scripts.translation: 古城是一座层数众多的巨大地下城。

scripts.text: This dungeon is definitely not for new or experienced adventurers
scripts.translation: 这座地下城并不适合新手或普通冒险者，
而是留给地下城探索老手的。

scripts.text: There are many fearsome monsters such as ^6B1312Dark Lord^000000,
scripts.translation: 这里有许多可怕的魔物，例如^6B1312黑暗之王^000000、

scripts.text: ^6B1312Owl Baron^000000, ^6B1312Owl Duke^000000, ^6B1312Dark Illusion^000000, ^6B1312Bloody Knight^000000, ^6B1312Abysmal Knight^000000, ^6B1312Chimera^000000 and various types of doomed swords.
However, more difficult the expedition is, greater the reward is.
scripts.translation: 不过，冒险越艰难，得到的回报也越丰厚。

scripts.text: Therefore, this dungeon is pretty popular among dungeon experts.
scripts.translation: 因此，这座地下城深受探索老手欢迎。
